episodes.title: The Never Dry
episodes.summary: Bailey refuses to leave Austin until she finds out the truth.

episodes.title: When We Were Young
episodes.summary: While Bailey confronts her past, Hannah must make a devastating decision about their future.

episodes.title: Sanctuary
episodes.summary: Season finale. Hannah risks everything to protect her family.

episodes.title: Cape Cod
episodes.summary: After five happy years in Los Angeles, Hannah and Bailey find themselves on the run from a familiar threat.

episodes.title: Safe

episodes.title: Ghosts

episodes.title: First-Date Material

episodes.title: The Prosecutor
episodes.summary: Hannah and Owen take their search for answers abroad while Bailey makes a shocking discovery about her mother.

episodes.summary: All roads lead to Paris for a long-awaited confrontation with the crime family patriarch.
